Package com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration.intervals.thresholdfactor

Class ThresholdFactorOptimizersEndToEndTest

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.navigation.inertial.calibration.intervals.thresholdfactor.ThresholdFactorOptimizersEndToEndTest
class ThresholdFactorOptimizersEndToEndTest extends Object
End-to-end tests of the threshold factor optimizers using a deterministic (seeded) synthetic IMU stream with known accelerometer and gyroscope parameters.
